AND containregistry IN (
    SELECT c.containregistry
    FROM container c
    JOIN vaccinedetails v ON c.containregistry = v.containvac

       AND ((1.0 - s.tempdevcount::numeric/100.0) * (1.0 - s.critevents::numeric/10.0) * s.tempstabidx) > 0.9
);
